summary: GPGI, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K on November 5, 2026, containing Item 2.02 disclosure of third-quarter results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, furnished via press release and investor presentation (Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2). Item 8.01 reports the board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.0025 per Class A share, payable December 1, 2026 to holders of record November 18, 2026. No transaction, activist, or structural event is present; the filing is ordinary earnings and dividend reporting with no risk-arb angle.
